item.title: New Firefighting Technologies Could Help Battle Blazes Like Those in France and Spain
item.description: Climate change is upping the odds of major wildfires, creating a need for new tools to combat them.

item.title: Thea Energy lands $20M federal grant to build its magnets for fusion reactors
item.description: Fusion power startup Thea Energy snagged a $20 million award from ARPA-E to scale production of its high-temperature superconducting magnets.

item.title: As rivals chase acquisitions, Peacock bets on bundles through a new deal with YouTube
item.description: The deal means content will be integrated into the YouTube experience, allowing viewers to discover and watch Peacock content without leaving the platform.

item.title: DHS Official Resigns, Citing ‘War on Immigrants’
item.description: The outgoing executive director of the Office of Homeland Security Statistics is one of very few federal officials to speak out against the Trump administration’s immigration crackdown.

item.title: Spotify is experiencing another major outage
item.description: A second gremlin is rolling through Spotify this evening.

item.title: Peut-on vraiment fuir un incendie en voiture électrique ? On compare avec une voiture essence
item.description: En quelques jours, l’incendie de Gironde a poussé 220 000 personnes à évacuer alors que le feu se rapproche de Bordeaux. À chaque évacuation de masse, la même question tombe : et en voiture électrique, on fait comment ? On a repris les mesures, pour comparer aux voitures essence et diesel.

item.title: PSA: Your Claude shared chats and Artifacts may have ended up on Google
item.description: The issue appears to have originated from Claude’s “share chat” feature, which allows users to create links that enable anyone with the assigned URL view a conversation or project.

item.title: Private Claude Chats Exposed in Google and Bing Search Results
item.description: The screwup shows how tricky it can be to stop web crawlers from making ostensibly private conversations with AI chatbots entirely too public.

item.title: iOS 26.6, macOS 26.6 and the rest are out, addressing security fixes
item.description: Apple's latest software updates are primarily focused on security fixes.

item.title: Can’t find the Chrome extension you want? I used Claude to make me two personalized ones — and they’re working flawlessly
item.description: One of the ways you can use your AI chatbot of choice is to customize your web browser to better suit your needs.

item.title: Xbox’s huge outage even blocked games on disc
item.description: An extended Xbox outage that began Sunday evening hasn't just caused issues for people trying to play digital games - it blocked people from playing their disc-based games, too. Xbox's status page initially reported the outage on Sunday at about 11PM ET, and it has also prevented people from logging in, launching apps, or finding […]

item.title: Lawyers, teachers, and students face consequences when they use AI to do their jobs. What about politicians?
item.description: After a Canadian legislator went viral for reading a prompt in a speech, some wonder if there’s a double standard when it comes to AI shortcuts. Artificial intelligence makes mistakes all the time: adding extra fingers to generated images of humans or hallucinating data just to please its user. But sometimes, mistakes rest entirely on the humans using it, a Canadian lawmaker has come to find out....
